 How To Protect Your Social Security Check From A 22% Cut
 Nov 15, 2026, 9:00 AM ET iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF (SGOV) , BIL , SP500 , SPY , DIA , QQQ , VOO , IWM , SPX , DJI , RTY 108 Comments 1 Like Luca Socci Investing Group Follow Summary
 The 2027 Social Security COLA is 3.6%, but it replaces purchasing power already lost to inflation rather than providing a real raise.
 Medicare premiums and unindexed tax thresholds can erode benefits; the larger risk is a potential 22% cut after trust fund depletion in 2032.
 I would delay claiming until 70, using T-bills to fund the three-year bridge and increase the lifetime benefit by 24%.
 A TIPS ladder can insure the remaining gap: estimated costs for 20 years of payments are $73,000 for a single retiree and $113,000 for a couple.
